_provenance.decision: Each nba.com PLAYER_ID below is the same person as the ESPN athlete id beside it. Verified by birth date: nba.com's team page and ESPN's core athlete record (sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/basketball/leagues/nba/athletes/<id>) publish the same date for every entry. All seven signed new contracts in late July 2026 that ESPN's 2026-08-04 roster had not yet reflected, so team and transaction-date evidence could not bind them. Two of the ESPN ids sit in players.nba_id, which holds hoopR's ESPN athlete ids, not NBA ids.
_provenance.used_by: ingest_nba_roster.py, as evidence for a sole name candidate whose ESPN id matches. Needed once: after the first publish these players carry an nba.com crosswalk row and resolve by exact id.
